cases.sdk_only: The world mounts a machine VFS, which the CLI lanes' yaml carries only for ram worlds.
cases.note: With the machine's disk at / and the machine taking @external, every line runs once in plain bash on the docker machine and once through Mirage, and the two answers must match byte for byte: program lookups, /usr/bin, a program the machine lacks under each wrapper, and the PATH and HOME a session starts with. Each step stands alone, since plain bash runs it in a shell of its own.

steps.command: which perl; which -a perl; type perl; type -t perl; type -a perl; command -v perl; command -V perl
type -P ldconfig; which -a ldconfig; command -v ldconfig; type ldconfig
which nosuch; echo rc=$?; type nosuch; echo rc=$?; command -V nosuch; echo rc=$?; command -v nosuch; echo rc=$?
which grep; type grep; command -v grep; type -t grep; type -P grep
type cd; type -t cd; command -v cd; which cd; echo rc=$?
[ -x /usr/bin/perl ] && echo runs; head -c 4 /usr/bin/perl | tail -c 3; echo; /usr/bin/perl -e 'print 1+1, qq(\n)'; ls /usr/bin | grep -x perl; ls /usr/bin/perl
perl -e 'print qq(on the machine\n)'; $(which perl) -e 'print 3*3, qq(\n)'
env nosuch; echo rc=$?; (exec nosuch); echo rc=$?; echo x | xargs nosuch; echo rc=$?; timeout 5 nosuch; echo rc=$?; nohup nosuch; echo rc=$?
